_comment: SAST exemption ledger (#4107). The visible remaining-debt list, same shape as proving/security/sweep-exemptions.json. Nothing is silently suppressed: run_sast fails loud if an entry here no longer matches a real finding, so a stale exemption cannot rot into a blind spot, and it fails on any finding NOT listed here.

exemptions.reason: The Clearing message write reads the sender name from the request body. The path is authenticated (#3966 closed the anonymous hole), so this is an authenticated caller asserting someone else's name, not an open door. Binding it needs a decision on what a shared-secret server-side caller's identity IS, which is design work, not a line edit.
The pulse nudge write reads the sender name from the request body. Same shape and same blocker as the Clearing entry above.
